test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A statement is given followed by two arguments numbered I and II. Study the statements and arguments carefully, and choose the appropriate answer from the given alternatives.

statement:

Compared to all apartments with the same square foot area, the rent for apartments above the sixth floor in most over-rise apartment

options.text: Argument I does not support the statement, while Argument II supports the statement.
Arguments I and II both support the statement.
Both the arguments I and II do not support the statement.
Reasoning II does not support the statement, while Reasoning I supports the statement.

solution:
The correct answer is **Argument I does not support the statement, while Argument II supports the statement.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In large cities, **apartments on higher floors** typically have **less air pollution.**
 
• Due to their proximity to the streets,** air pollutants like dust and grime** are more likely to** settle on lower levels **unless there is a strong wind to carry them there.
 
• Few people can access a building's upper stories. Even if you avoid the stairs, there are just more people and levels to pass through on the upper floors, therefore the wait time for the elevator is longer. Furniture and everyday objects like groceries and shopping bags may be difficult to move as a result.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lower floors **of a highrise are typically the "**least glamorous"** option. They are significantly less expensive as a result. People will be able to save a significant amount of money when they take into account their lower air conditioning expenditures.
 
• For residents in townhouses, living on the **ground floor** could also mean having access to a **backyard or courtyard.**
 
• This is a benefit for tenants who have children, or pets or enjoy having parties outside.
